question: The factors of x⁴ + x² + 25 are :
solution:
**Formula used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a + b)(a - b) = a² - b²

**Calculation:**

x⁴ + x² + 25

It can be written as (x²)² + 2 × x² × 5 + (5)² - (3x)²

⇒ x4 + 10x2 + 25 - 9x2

⇒ (x² + 5)² - (3x)²

⇒ (x² + 5 + 3x)(x² + 5 - 3x)

**∴ The factors of x⁴ + x² + 25 are (x2 + 3x + 5) (x2 - 3x + 5).**
